description: Revision Kohn-Sham solver (Revision/kohn_sham/solver): instantaneous Kohn-Sham states of dirac16complex in the author's primordial field, the corrected primordial metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2; SPEC section 1): g = diag(e^{-2a4} b4 cot^2 z, e^{2a4} (x3), -1, -e^{-2a4} b4 (sin^2 z)^{1/6} (x3)), z = 6 H x0 real, along the PRESCRIBED history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^{(4/3) H x4} (b4(0) = 1; SPEC sections 1 and 7, Revision/kohn_sham/ks-theory.json). The author's coordinates {x0, ..., x7}: x0 = hidden direction (y = ln|sin z|/(6H) <= 0 on every quarter, the fold cos z = 0 at y = 0), x1..x3 = 3-space, x4 = time, x5..x7 = the extra times; in the y chart ds^2 = e^{2a4} dx_{1..3}^2 - dx4^2 + f^2 [dy^2 - e^{2Hy} dx_{5..7}^2], f = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} = e^{-a4/3} on the history.

theoryInputs.adiabaticityHistory: a4 = A H x4 (A = 1 canonical), b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4} (beta = 4/3, b4(0) = 1), a4' = A H, b4'/b4 = beta A H, f = e^{(beta/2 - 1) a4} = e^{-a4/3}; slices a4,0 = a4(x4), b4,0 = e^{beta a4,0}; PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND (see historyStatus)

units: H = 1, m = 1: energies, momenta, temperatures in units of m = H. The record uses b4(0) = 1 (ks-theory.json densities.proper): lambda = lambda_hat = lambda b4(0)^{-2} in units of m^-6, the same at every slice; Vol_7(a4,0) = ell^3 v_t e^{-a4,0} b4,0^2 = ell^3 v_t e^{(2 beta - 1) a4,0} = ell^3 v_t e^{(5/3) a4,0} (the proper 7-volume of the cell per unit e^{3Hy}); the hidden scale f = e^{-a4,0} b4,0^{1/2} = e^{-a4,0/3} multiplies the hidden derivative (chi' = f N chi; the proper hidden length of the cell is f L); every density, profile and pressure is the proper one; energies, levels, potentials, particle numbers and the integrals 2 Vol_7 int e^{3Hy} (...) dy are the physical ones. Equivalently (ks-theory.json densities.couplingVolumeScaling) a slice state is the state of the coordinate cell ell^3 v_t at lambda_eff = lambda_hat e^{-(5/3) a4,0}, at the same f and kappa

physics.Vol7Rule: Vol_7(a4,0) = ell^3 v_t e^{(2 beta - 1) a4,0}

particleNumbers.rule: N = 8 (the k = 0 fold zero modes, both block types); N_large = the largest closed shell of the free a4,0 = 0 aufbau whose last filled level lies below the bulk edge (the lowest level not on the even j = +1 fold band: min of the odd l = 0 and even l = 1 levels at k = 0); N_mid = the closed shell (>= 8, below the bulk edge) nearest N_large / 4

couplingCalibration.rule: per N, from the free ground states of that N at every slice a4,0 of the history: strength = max over the slices and over y of max((15/16)|S(y)|, |n(y)|/16) (the proper densities, per Vol_7(a4,0) = ell^3 v_t e^{(5/3) a4,0} and with the factor e^{-3Hy}), the first-order mean-field potential per unit lambda_hat; lambda_1 = 0.1/strength and lambda_2 = 0.3/strength rounded to 4 significant digits, so that the first-order mean-field potential stays below 0.1 m and 0.3 m along the whole history (strengthPerLambdaAtSlices shows at which slice it is largest); lambda_hat = lambda b4(0)^{-2} is a constant of the theory, the same at every slice

conventions.particleNumber: N = sum g f over both fold conditions = particle number of the cell (the two halves z < pi/2 and z > pi/2 joined at the fold); each half holds N/2 (ks-theory.json densities.total). The thermodynamics line 'mu fixed by sum w g f = N' of ks-theory.json is inconsistent with this and with its own Omega = -T sum g ln(...) + ..., F = Omega + mu N; the solver uses sum g f = N (noted as a discrepancy of the theory file)
conventions.filling: particles occupy the positive branch (labels whose lambda = 0 level at the same slice is positive) and the k = 0 fold zero modes (CONVENTION of ks-theory.json, justification OPEN); the negative branch is the normal-ordered sea and is not populated thermally (the excluded thermal sea holes are reported as a diagnostic)
conventions.brane: the fold y = 0 (cos z = 0) joins the two halves of a cell: the fold condition (1 - Q(theta)) chi(0) = 0 follows from self-adjointness up to theta; both theta = 0 (b(0) = 0, 'even') and theta = pi (a(0) = 0, 'odd') are solved and filled (ASSUMED convention of the record, ks-theory.json boundaryConditions.fold); tip: regular, theta = 0 (b(-L) = 0); kappa does not grow toward the tip, so the extended levels depend on L like a box of proper length f L (only the fold-localised states have an L-independent limit). The key keeps the name 'brane' of the earlier record
conventions.instantaneous: states at fixed a4,0 = a4(x4) are instantaneous (adiabatic) Kohn-Sham states; the non-adiabatic (time-dependent) problem is OPEN
conventions.history: PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND: the history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^{(4/3) H x4} is prescribed, not solved for. With the author's Lovelock weights the a4 and b4 equations of SPEC section 5 allow it only with a diagonal source with p0 = p_t that grows with x4 (Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json, exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource_kappaT_minus_Lam); whether the Kohn-Sham states along it supply this source is evaluated in Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json. The Kohn-Sham gas is therefore a test field on a prescribed background without back-reaction, and quantities derived along this history (energies, pressures, equations of state) are not consequences of the coupled field equations. (ks-theory.json adiabaticity.historyStatus)
conventions.b4: b4 enters the slice Hamiltonian through the hidden scale f = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} (h_j = j[-(i/f) sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v; ks-theory.json sectorAndAnsatz: Psi = e^{ik.x} e^{-(3/2)Hy} e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} chi), the proper cell volume Vol_7(a4,0) (the effective coupling lambda_hat/Vol_7(a4,0) ~ e^{-(5/3) a4,0}) and the history identity dE/da4 = -3 P3 - 3 (beta/2 - 1) P_t - (beta/2 - 1) P0; the lambda = 0 levels depend on a4 and b4 only through kappa k and f L (rescaling identity)
conventions.merminRoot: mu from sum g f = N with the well-conditioned residual of solver/src/mermin.rs: thermal particles above and holes below a split of the levels (complementary Fermi factors f(-x), never 1 - f), canonical form LogBalance (log-sum-exp balance, Newton + bisection), refined run LinearDeviation (an exactly equivalent form with a different rounding path); the former direct count sum g f - N fixed mu only to eps_mach N/(dN/dmu) (8.3e-10 m in N8_lamm1_a00_T10)
conventions.deltaScf: first excited state: one particle moved from the highest occupied degenerate group to the lowest empty group, spread uniformly over each group (ensemble Delta-SCF, keeps the block and direction symmetry of the reduction)
conventions.exactExchange: canonical functional = Hartree + exact local exchange of the uniform 8-fold gas (exact at every temperature for p -> -p symmetric occupations); the exact Fock exchange of the closed-shell slab determinant differs by +lambda Q^2/32 (reported as deltaE_x and solved as a variant)
